# Gods Promise Aluminium

> Gods Promise Aluminium (Gods Promise Aluminium Concept Limited) is a leading aluminium roofing manufacturer and supplier in Lagos, Nigeria — producing long span sheets, step tiles, Metcopo sheets and supplying Gerard stone-coated tiles for residential, commercial and religious buildings across Nigeria. Fast WhatsApp quotes and nationwide delivery.

## Company Information

- **Legal name:** Gods Promise Aluminium Concept Limited
- **Address:** Pleasure Bus Stop, Alimosho, Lagos 100275, Lagos, Nigeria
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +234 915 045 9964
- **Website:** https://www.godspromisealuminiumroofing.com
- **Opening hours:** Monday – Saturday, 08:00 – 18:00

## Gerard Roofing Nails (wholesale)

- **Price:** ₦23,000 per 20kg carton (wholesale, Lagos factory price). Bulk discounts available.
- **Packaging:** 4 packs × 5kg = 20kg per carton. Sold by the carton.
- **Size:** BWG 12 × 2" coated wire nails (2.77mm wire, 50mm long), diamond point, black coated.
- **Made by:** Simplex Industrial Limited.
- **Who buys:** roofing sheet dealers, building materials shops, roofing companies, warehouse owners and contractors.
- **Launch:** over 2,000 cartons sold within 24 hours of launch; the launch earned the company an award.
- **Order:** WhatsApp or call +234 915 045 9964 with the number of cartons and your location, or buy online. Pickup at Pleasure Bus Stop, Alimosho, Lagos; delivery nationwide.
- [Product page](https://www.godspromisealuminiumroofing.com/store/gerard-nail): price, specifications, videos and FAQ.
